entities.name: Re-authentication procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF to create a new 5G NAS security context. Messages exchanged during authentication are integrity protected and ciphered using current security context.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF to establish new or modified 5G NAS security context. Involves SECURITY MODE COMMAND and SECURITY MODE COMPLETE messages.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to initiate security mode control procedure. Includes ngKSI of new or modified security context and sent integrity protected with new/modified context but unciphered.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE in response to SECURITY MODE COMMAND. Sent integrity protected and ciphered with new or modified 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key set identifier for 5G NAS security context. Used in SECURITY MODE COMMAND to indicate which security context to use or modify.

entities.name: NAS security algorithms
entities.description: Set of selected NAS security algorithms included in SECURITY MODE COMMAND when modifying existing security context.

entities.name: Current 5G NAS security context
entities.description: The currently active 5G NAS security context used by UE and AMF until security mode control procedure is initiated.

entities.name: New 5G NAS security context
entities.description: New security context created through re-authentication and established via security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Modified 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Existing security context modified by changing security algorithms through security mode control procedure.

relations.description: Messages during re-authentication are integrity protected and ciphered using current security context.
Security mode control procedure involves sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Security mode control procedure involves receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND includes ngKSI of the security context to be used.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND includes new set of selected NAS security algorithms when modifying context.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND is integrity protected with new security context but unciphered.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND is integrity protected with modified security context but unciphered.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE is integrity protected and ciphered with new security context.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE is integrity protected and ciphered with modified security context.
Security mode control procedure establishes transition from current to new/modified security context.
